method: Activated Insights interviewed residents and families. The operator describes a national comparison pool of more than 1,800 senior care organizations. That is a provider count; the publications omit per-location respondent counts, response rates, field dates and underlying satisfaction averages.

awards.comparison: The operator reports that Longview earned 2026 customer experience honors in the top 15% of participating providers in the listed service categories.
awards.releaseScope: Longview Assisted Living only. No separate performance claim for its memory-care neighborhood.
awards.identity: NJ DOH license 5a005 is the Christian Health Care Center assisted-living residence with 95 beds and telephone (201) 848-4300. Note 1 of the audited 2025 accounts identifies the operator’s 95-bed Wyckoff assisted-living residence as Longview. The operator directory ties Longview to that telephone. The DOH lists the campus's 301 Sicomac address; the operator identifies the Longview visitor address as 311 Sicomac.

subunitScope: The provider cost report covers the 2025 calendar year and identifies Heritage Manor and Southgate under the same CCN in worksheet S-2. Only Southgate and Heritage Manor Unit 2 appear at the cited ranks. Neither rank represents the full CCN, the assisted-living residence or The Vista.
use: Qualitative award for Longview; precisely labeled subunit ranks for named units only. No Harbor score, response-count input or satisfaction percentage.
